paper.title: LUCID: Learning Embodiment-Agnostic Intent Models from Unstructured Human Videos for Scalable Dexterous Robot Skill Acquisition

claim: LUCID 的人视频监督依赖四级提取链（ViPE 深度/相机、SAM 3.1 分割、DenseTrack3Dv2 物体点追踪、WiLoR 手部 MANO 网格拟合），作者自述每一级都是数据提取与部署时的故障点，in-hand occlusion 与无纹理物体等感知故障会沿链传播到 sensorimotor 策略。

evidence.summary: 5 Limitations (1) 逐项命名四个组件并称各自引入故障点，明确'Perception faults like in-hand occlusion or textureless objects propagate down the chain to the sensorimotor policy'；3.1 详述四级管线职责。
evidence.short_quote: (1) Pipeline brittleness. The system is over-modularized; SAM 3.1, DenseTrack3Dv2, ViPE, and WiLoR each introduce a failure point during data extraction and at deployment. Perception faults like in-hand occlusion or textureless objects propagate down the chain to the sensorimotor policy.

core_citations: K. Karaulov et al., WiLoR: End-to-end 3D hand localization and reconstruction in-the-wild, 2024 — palm pose 来源
N. Karaev et al., CoTracker3, 2024 — 意图模型架构基础
M. Xu et al., Flow as the cross-domain manipulation interface, CoRL 2024 — flow 接口思想来源
notes: B10 批次第 5 篇。该篇代表'意图级'使用人视频的路线，与直接轨迹重定向路线（EgoAERO/Do as I Do/VideoManip）形成精度需求对照：它把精确手部轨迹的需求替换为粗略 palm pose + 闭环重查询。reader_inferred 已标注 palm pose 精度未独立量化、73/28 对照混杂视频生成因素。

paper_reading.relation: 给出无本体人视频路线中手部/物体检测误差的显式传播路径：感知链模块化故障点→意图参考→控制策略
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 引文逐字出自 5 Limitations 第 (1) 条；claim 组件职责与 3.1 管线描述一致（ViPE=相机/深度、SAM 3.1=mask、DenseTrack3Dv2=物体点追踪、WiLoR=MANO 手网格），未超出作者陈述范围。

paper.title: LUCID: Learning Embodiment-Agnostic Intent Models from Unstructured Human Videos for Scalable Dexterous Robot Skill Acquisition

claim: 在同一 sensorimotor 策略下，闭环重查询意图的 LUCID 在三个 web 监督真实任务上平均成功率 73%，显著高于开环视频生成 planner 的 28%；开环在执行偏离（如 misgrasp 后勺子移位）时因陈旧参考使策略混乱失败。

evidence.summary: 1 Introduction 报告 73% vs 28%；4.1 描述开环基线在 misgrasp 后陈旧参考导致策略混乱，LUCID 在抓取偏差或物体移位时重查询场景并重定向策略。
evidence.short_quote: Closed-loop LUCID achieves 73% average success on the web-supervised tasks vs 28% for an open-loop baseline, and the same intent model drives both embodiments with comparable success (63%) on the smartphone-collected tasks.

core_citations: K. Karaulov et al., WiLoR: End-to-end 3D hand localization and reconstruction in-the-wild, 2024 — palm pose 来源
N. Karaev et al., CoTracker3, 2024 — 意图模型架构基础
M. Xu et al., Flow as the cross-domain manipulation interface, CoRL 2024 — flow 接口思想来源
notes: B10 批次第 5 篇。该篇代表'意图级'使用人视频的路线，与直接轨迹重定向路线（EgoAERO/Do as I Do/VideoManip）形成精度需求对照：它把精确手部轨迹的需求替换为粗略 palm pose + 闭环重查询。reader_inferred 已标注 palm pose 精度未独立量化、73/28 对照混杂视频生成因素。

paper_reading.relation: 支持'闭环重查询可吸收含噪手部/物体参考带来的误差'这一缓解手段：与其提高单帧检测精度，不如周期性从实时场景重建意图
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 73%/28% 逐字出现于 1 Introduction 并在 4.1 展开；claim 限定于同一策略的三任务真实评测，注明开环失败机制来自 4.1 正文，未将差距完全归因于感知误差（基线含视频生成因素）。

quantitative.value_or_direction: 73% average success vs 28% for an open-loop baseline
quantitative.comparator: open-loop planner (Veo 3.1) driving the same sensorimotor policy
quantitative.task_or_sample: stirring/wiping/binning 三任务，各 10 trials × 3 scenarios
quantitative.locator: 1 Introduction; 4.1 Real-World Capability on Web-Scraped Tasks

paper.title: LUCID: Learning Embodiment-Agnostic Intent Models from Unstructured Human Videos for Scalable Dexterous Robot Skill Acquisition

claim: LUCID 有意将手部重建降级为'粗略 palm pose'：WiLoR 的 MANO 手网格逐帧刚体拟合到深度得到 palm pose，与物体 flow 共同构成短视野意图参考，精细手指构型与接触被显式丢弃并委托给仿真 RL 策略；作者承认该有损接口即使在意图准确时也缺失完整复现人类演示所需线索。

evidence.summary: 3.1 定义 intent 为 'object motion and rough palm pose' 并描述 WiLoR→刚体拟合→palm pose 链路；5 Limitations (3) 自述接口丢弃 finger configuration and fine contact、即使意图准确也缺失复现线索。
evidence.short_quote: We define manipulation intent as a short-horizon prediction of object motion and rough palm pose, shared across embodiments; the joint-level commands that realize it are delegated to a separate sensorimotor policy.

core_citations: K. Karaulov et al., WiLoR: End-to-end 3D hand localization and reconstruction in-the-wild, 2024 — palm pose 来源
N. Karaev et al., CoTracker3, 2024 — 意图模型架构基础
M. Xu et al., Flow as the cross-domain manipulation interface, CoRL 2024 — flow 接口思想来源
notes: B10 批次第 5 篇。该篇代表'意图级'使用人视频的路线，与直接轨迹重定向路线（EgoAERO/Do as I Do/VideoManip）形成精度需求对照：它把精确手部轨迹的需求替换为粗略 palm pose + 闭环重查询。reader_inferred 已标注 palm pose 精度未独立量化、73/28 对照混杂视频生成因素。

paper_reading.relation: 说明一条绕开手部检测精度瓶颈的设计路线：降低对手部轨迹精度的依赖（rough palm pose），代价是接口信息损失限制可复现的动作精细度
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 引文逐字出自 3.1 开头定义段；WiLoR 拟合链路与 Limitations (3) 的有损接口陈述均在正文对应位置可查证；claim 把两处信息组合为设计权衡，未超出原文语义。
